events.title: Naming the Moment: Revolutionary Strategy in a Time of Crisis
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: Since Donald Trump’s return to power, many leftists have grappled with the question, How do we combat the Trump regime in ways that promote systemic liberatory change? The 2026 pamphlet Naming the Moment: Revolutionary Strategy in a Time of Crisis, by an ad hoc group of radical organizers, is a recent attempt to foster to this discussion. In this event, project participant Matthew N. Lyons will share highlights of the pamphlet, relate it to other writings on the topic, and invite discussion of the challenges and opportunities we face, and strategies for beating the authoritarians and creating a new world.

events.title: Red Rabbits De-Escalation training
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: Join the Red Rabbis for their De-Escalation 101 training to learn some basics surrounding de-escalation practices that can be used towards greater community care int he streets or on the ground.  We will discuss ways to keep ourselves grounded, and practice co-regulation through tension and conflicts.  Great for organizers interested in practicing community safety/care in addition to public workers.  Every second Friday of the month at the Shoe.  Masks required and provided!

events.title: Film Screening of The Mauritanian, Commemorating 25 Years of the War of Terror
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description:
Behind Enemy Lines is commemorating 25 years of The War of Terror with a free film screening of The Mauritanian on Sunday, September 13th at 6:30PM at the Wooden Shoe Books in Philly. The film is an adaptation of Mohamedou Ould Slahi’s diary, retelling his 14-year extrajudicial detention and torture at Guantánamo Bay.

Never forgive, never forget the crimes of US imperialism.
